image.name: odq-kde
image.package_pinning: Image immutable; apt packages use current Ubuntu noble repositories, not an immutable package snapshot. Record dpkg versions after provisioning.
image.rendering: Emulated virtual GPU only, no physical GPU/input/audio passthrough. Guest Mesa is configured for llvmpipe. Virtual GPU must expose a working DRM/KMS device for KWin Wayland.

capture.backend: Spectacle 23.08 forced to Qt Wayland via KWin org.kde.KWin.ScreenShot2, never the XWayland screenshot backend
capture.limitations: Run as odq in the existing Plasma Wayland session with its session D-Bus and WAYLAND_DISPLAY. A root incus exec with fabricated environment is not equivalent. Spectacle is privileged by desktop identity; arbitrary clients lack generic Wayland screenshot access. Permission prompts, denial and timeout fail capture; no security-policy overrides or X11 fallback. PNG header validation is not proof of correct pixels: decode and inspect the returned image. Does not qualify host GPU, input, audio or arbitrary Wayland backends.

image.qualification_status: Runtime smoke status and limits are tracked in maintenance/phase3-lab.md.
